title.zh: 对第 9094 号共和国法的修改
title.en: An Act Amending Republic Act No. 9094, Entitled "An Act Declaring the Seventh (7th) Day of January of Every Year as a Special Working Public Holiday in the Province of Camiguin to Be Known as 'Araw Ng Camiguin'"
title.orig: An Act Amending Republic Act No. 9094, Entitled "An Act Declaring the Seventh (7th) Day of January of Every Year as a Special Working Public Holiday in the Province of Camiguin to Be Known as 'Araw Ng Camiguin'"

text.en:
Republic Act no. 9094, otherwise known as "An Act Declaring the Seventh (7th) Day of January of Every Year as a Special Working Public Holiday in the Province of Camiguin to be known as 'Araw ng Camiguin'", is hereby amended to read as follows:
"Section 1. January seven of every year is hereby declared as a special nonworking holiday in the Province of Camiguin to commemorate its charter day anniversary.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
